name: HyperliquidX 0.1.9
body:
HyperliquidX 0.1.9 improves startup reliability on macOS 14.

- Address an early startup crash when the HTTP connection installs its network decoder by using a compatible SwiftNIO release.
- Check HTTP and WebSocket decoder compatibility before opening connections, and extend packaged-app verification on Apple Silicon and Intel.
- Add Settings → Privacy → Share crash reports with HyperliquidX, with a saved collection preference and an explanation of restart behavior.
